sources.baseline_audit.1: Ground-truth defect 1: only 68/205 Prisma models have migrations; RLS references absent tables; migrate deploy cannot build a working DB.
sources.baseline_audit.2: Ground-truth defect 2: tenant allowlist covers 27 of 124 schoolId models; RLS fails open with NULL tenant; app does not set it; payments.ts constructs a bare client.
sources.baseline_audit.3: Ground-truth defect 3: payment ownership/signature/partial-payment checks, webhook verification, idempotence, atomic ledger posting, and consistent ledger engines are defective.
sources.baseline_audit.4: Ground-truth defect 4: 71 monetary fields are Float and late fine is hard-coded to 50.
sources.baseline_audit.5: Ground-truth defect 5: secrets are present in git history; HUMAN must rotate credentials.
sources.baseline_audit.6: Ground-truth defect 6: bank reconciliation and goods receipt return return 501 because schema fields are missing.
sources.baseline_audit.7: Ground-truth defect 7: 365 endpoints are REVIEW_REQUIRED in ROUTE_AUTHORIZATION_MATRIX.md.
sources.baseline_audit.8: Ground-truth defect 8: portal coverage gaps, hard-coded localhost URLs, and tokens in localStorage.
sources.baseline_audit.9: Ground-truth defect 9: about 120 tests without DB-backed run, placeholder E2E, CI never run, backend lint problems, and removed TS options; correction says TS 5.9.3 tsc passes and tsconfig must not change.
sources.baseline_audit.10: Ground-truth defect 10: public/duplicate metrics, anonymous Grafana, exposed/default database and Redis, unpinned images, runtime mismatch, HS256 fallback, and repository junk.

requirements.summary: A clean PostgreSQL database is built by the committed migration chain, and all 205 model tables exist.
A clean migrated database has an empty Prisma schema diff.
The payment_transactions invoiceId/transactionId unique constraint exists after migration.
Existing database adoption and migration-history reconciliation are documented and reviewed.
Mounted sensitive endpoints have reviewed authentication, role, tenant, and ownership rules; no route remains REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Token validation uses the approved asymmetric algorithm with no insecure fallback.
Operational endpoints and dashboards require authentication and authorization.
Credential exposure remediation is complete, including rotation and downstream exposure review.
Every Prisma model has a reviewed direct, indirect, or global ownership classification; additions fail CI if unclassified.
Tenant RLS covers every classified tenant table and denies access when the tenant setting is absent.
Every authenticated request uses a transaction whose first statement sets transaction-local tenant context; authenticated API isolation tests pass.
Pre-auth, webhook, worker, and audited super-admin operations use explicit trusted connections with tests and audit records.
All tenant Prisma reads and writes, including nested writes and upserts, are scoped from generated classification data.
No application module creates a PrismaClient outside the central Prisma module.
Payment creation and verification enforce invoice/student ownership, provider order binding, amount, currency, and outstanding balance.
Invalid signatures cannot mutate another user's payment, and partial payments do not mark invoices fully paid.
Webhook signatures use raw bytes, constant-time comparison, mandatory secrets, and duplicate-delivery protection in all environments.
Payment state and ledger posting are atomic; ledger failure is surfaced and no parallel inconsistent ledger engine remains.
Ledger entries balance per posted transaction and posted rows reject UPDATE/DELETE, with database tests.
Financial monetary schema fields use exact decimal arithmetic; unspecified policy defaults are documented for owner approval.
Bank reconciliation and goods receipt return workflows are schema-backed rather than 501 placeholders.
All seven portals build and have authenticated browser smoke coverage against configured API endpoints.
The full backend suite passes without skipped tests, weakened assertions, or suite-setup cascades.
CI provides isolated PostgreSQL and Redis resources per lane, with RLS tests asserting a non-superuser, non-BYPASSRLS role.
Browser E2E runs real portal workflows against the API with isolated, reproducible fixtures.
Backend lint, type-check, and build all pass without weakened rules or suppressed errors.
An independent clean-clone audit re-runs required gates and confirms evidence provenance and lane claims.
Production database, Redis, dashboards, metrics, and container images have reviewed access and deployment configuration.
Runtime versions, lockfile paths, and dependency advisories are reviewed; no open high/critical advisory remains.
Portals provide the explicitly listed missing procurement workflow.
Portals provide the explicitly listed missing inventory workflow.
